title: Plugin translation namespaces
summary: MyAPES Account plugins now load their own UK English translation namespaces, and Admin Plugins shows plugin names and descriptions from those lang files. CI also runs a report-only translation key check.
changes: Load Cases, Tickets, Recruitment, Consultations, and Pet Profiles translations under cases::, tickets::, recruitment::, consultations::, and pet_profiles:: namespaces.
Seed each plugin’s en_GB plugin.php with name, short_name, description, and keywords; Admin Plugins labels resolve via nameKey and descriptionKey.
Allow app-level overrides in lang/vendor/{namespace}/en_GB without changing plugin packages.
Add php artisan lang:check (report-only) to CI for missing/unused keys and hard-coded string counts; hard-fail remains for a later Language wave.
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.38.x Language line: plugin namespace wiring and report-only CI scaffolding — no broad string extraction yet.
validation: PHPUnit PluginTranslationNamespacesTest (namespace resolution, Admin Plugins labels, vendor override, disabled-plugin safety, lang:check report-only).
Related Structure / Admin plugins / inventory tests on the PR branch.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
Local verify equivalent (changelog-validate, focused PHPUnit, frontend checks / build as available) before merge.
known_limitations: Most user-facing Blade and flash strings remain hard-coded until Wave 2 extraction.
lang:check does not fail CI yet; hard-fail for missing keys is deferred to Wave 4 (#276).
Admin search keywords (#274) are seeded in lang but the search UI is not in this release.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. Plugin labels fall back to English manifest text if translation files are removed; no database migrations are included.
provenance: Issue #272 (namespaces); #276 report-only CI scaffold in the same patch; pull request #315.
